Joe Lacob bought the Warriors for $450 million in 2010! Today, the franchise is worth $11 BILLION 💰 But when Stephen Curry arrived in Golden State one year earlier, the Warriors were valued at just $315 million. Since then, Curry became the face of the greatest era in franchise history. 🏆Four championships. 🏆Six Finals appearances. 🏆A dynasty that changed basketball forever. Now, though, Golden State’s priorities appear to be shifting. A recent NBC Sports Bay Area report suggested the 2026-27 season could become a “gap year” for the Warriors, with the organization potentially prioritizing internal development rather than making another major push around Curry. And that’s where the story gets uncomfortable. Steph isn’t retired. He isn’t washed. He still wants to compete for championships. Yet Golden State may already be preparing for the world after him. Lacob turned a $450M investment into an $11B franchise. Curry helped make that transformation possible. So after everything Steph has given Golden State, should the Warriors really be planning for the next era while he’s still here? 🤔
